meta.title: Privacy Policy | Red Pen Review
meta.description: How Red Pen Review collects and uses your information.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body: When you sign up to receive the free guide or our newsletter, we collect your email address. We do not collect any other personal information unless you provide it to us directly.

sections.heading: How we use your information
sections.body: We use your email address to send you the free Red Pen Clarity starter guide and occasional notes on mental clarity, reflection, and journaling. We do not sell, share, or rent your personal information to third parties.

sections.heading: Email marketing
sections.body: Our emails are sent through a third-party email service provider. By subscribing, you agree to receive emails from us. You can unsubscribe at any time using the link at the bottom of any email we send.

sections.heading: Cookies and analytics
sections.body: This website does not use tracking cookies or third-party advertising trackers. We may use privacy-respecting analytics to understand aggregate visitor patterns, but this data is not linked to individual identities.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time. To do so, please contact us directly at the email address below.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: For privacy-related questions, please contact us at hello@redpenjournaling.com.
